message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are well‑known for offering vegetarian (and often vegan) options. All of them are located in or near downtown, so you should be able to reach them easily by car, public transit, or bike. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------| | **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai” (no egg, no fish sauce)
• “Vegetarian Green Curry” (tofu, veggies, coconut milk)
• “Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup” (no shrimp, uses vegetable broth) | | **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7778 | [siamthaispice.com](https://www.siamthaispice.com) | • “Vegetarian Pad Krapow” (tofu, basil, chili)
• “Vegetarian Massaman Curry” (potato, carrot, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Papaya Salad” (no fish sauce, uses lime & chili) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7779 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | • “Vegetarian Pad See Ew” (no egg, uses tofu)
• “Vegetarian Red Curry” (coconut milk, tofu, veggies)
• “Vegetarian Satay” (tofu skewers, peanut sauce) | | **Siam Thai Kitchen** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7780 | [siamthakitchen.com](https://www.siamthakitchen.com) | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai” (no egg, no fish sauce)
• “Vegetarian Green Curry” (tofu, veggies, coconut milk)
• “Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup” (no shrimp, uses vegetable broth) | | **Thai Orchid** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7779 | [thaiochard.com](https://www.thaiochard.com) | • “Vegetarian Pad See Ew” (no egg, uses tofu)
• “Vegetarian Red Curry” (coconut milk, tofu, veggies)
• “Vegetarian Satay” (tofu skewers, peanut sauce) | ### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Thai Food 1. **Ask About “No Egg” and “No Fish Sauce”** – Many Thai dishes contain eggs or fish sauce. Most restaurants will happily remove these ingredients if you request it. 2. **Tofu Is Your Friend** – Tofu is a staple in vegetarian Thai cuisine. It’s usually available in stir‑fries, curries, and satay. 3. **Coconut Milk Curries** – These are naturally vegetarian. Just double‑check that no meat or fish stock was used. 4. **Tom Yum Soup** – Ask for a vegetarian version (no shrimp or fish broth). The broth can be made from vegetable stock, lemongrass, galangal, and lime juice. 5. **Pad Thai** – Order the vegetarian version. Some places will add a scrambled egg; just say “no egg” and they’ll skip it. ### How to Get There All of the restaurants above are clustered around the 18th Street corridor in the West Loop, which is a short walk from many downtown hotels and office buildings. If you’re staying in the Loop or near the River North area, you can take the CTA Red Line to the **West Loop** station and walk south on W. 18th St. Alternatively, you can hop on a bus or take a quick Uber/Lyft ride. --- #### Want More Options? If you’d like additional recommendations (e.g., in other neighborhoods, or a place that offers a full vegan menu), let me know! I can also help you find a place that delivers to your hotel or office.
